title: Bands of his youth and the best trumpeters: Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly, Kid Rena
summary: He lists the bands he remembered and says he played second to Chris Kelly. Buddy Petit was his favourite, for low notes, and Kid Rena had the high notes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, do you remember any of the bands that were playing at the time when you first got interested in music?
What were a few of those?

I remember Buddy P.T., Chris Kelly, Kid Rene, Sam Morgan, and young Sam Morgan's band. Tuxedo, brass, and string band. Do you remember which of those musicians impressed you the most? Well, most of the trumpet players, like Buddy. I used to play second with Chris Kelly.
Who did you think was the best of trumpet players that you've heard in the New Orleans style? Well, I liked Buddy the best.
He featured mostly low notes. No high note, man. What? When it comes from high note, I don't believe nobody could beat Kid Rene. He could go higher than Lewis at one time.
